name: opencode-notifications
description: OpenCode sounds and terminal status. Standalone on local Linux; Remote SSH also requires OpenCode Notification Bridge on the SSH host.

commands.title: OpenCode Notifications: Install OpenCode Plugin on This Host
OpenCode Notifications: Enable Terminal Status Titles

opencodeNotifications.soundsEnabled.description: Enable automatic sounds. Toggle using OpenCode Notifications: Toggle Sounds.

opencodeNotifications.volume.description: Shared sound volume from 1 (quiet) to 10 (full volume). Used when a sound's own volume is unset or null, including previews and tests.

opencodeNotifications.completion.enabled.description: Play a local sound when a prompt completes.

opencodeNotifications.completion.path.description: Absolute local path to your completion sound. Empty uses the built-in chime.

opencodeNotifications.completion.volume.description: Completion sound volume from 1 (quiet) to 10 (full volume), including previews and tests. Unset or null uses the shared volume setting.

opencodeNotifications.attention.enabled.description: Play a local sound for a new question or permission request.

opencodeNotifications.attention.path.description: Absolute local path to your attention sound. Empty uses the built-in attention chime.

opencodeNotifications.attention.volume.description: Attention sound volume from 1 (quiet) to 10 (full volume), including previews and tests. Unset or null uses the shared volume setting.

opencodeNotifications.showNotifications.description: Show a VS Code notification when a prompt completes, needs input, or fails.
